description: Defines independent test-quality-strategy comprehension cases for browser and fixture overlap, mock and header overlap, semantic substitution, schema-header selection, and a core-only tiny-unit skip.

cases.title: Independently plan authenticated dashboard smoke QA

executor_input.prompt: Independently plan authenticated dashboard smoke QA.

context.content: Browser or manual QA is planned. It has not been run. Remote database permission is absent.

criteria.description: The reader independently requires both browser and manual-fixture procedures, states real prerequisites and observation limits, and refuses remote data mutation.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/smoke-e2e-and-browser.md and references/manual-qa-and-fixtures.md and skips references/test-plan-headers.md and references/mocking-and-regression.md. The unsplit baseline is judged on the same behavior without future-reference obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Select only one matching procedure, claim an unrun browser result, or modify remote data.

safety_vetoes.description: The reader misses either matching procedure or fabricates browser/manual evidence.

cases.title: Independently review a payment regression test

executor_input.prompt: Independently review a multi-branch payment regression test with a provider mock.

context.content: The task creates, changes, or reviews a non-trivial integration, API, form-interaction, multi-branch Server Action, important-regression, concurrency, RLS, or multi-group test file.

criteria.description: The reader independently selects mock/regression and test-header procedures, mocks only the provider, preserves the database invariant, and keeps verification metadata truthful.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/mocking-and-regression.md and references/test-plan-headers.md and skips references/smoke-e2e-and-browser.md and references/manual-qa-and-fixtures.md. The unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Read browser or fixture procedures without a trigger, mock the RPC, or preserve a stale passed header.

cases.title: Independently design a semantic relationship regression

executor_input.prompt: Independently design regression protection for an artifact graph that can mix individually valid evidence from different decisions.

context.content: Two complete valid graphs share the same run and summary but have distinct decision, acceptance identity, and accepted scope. One report must be authorized by one exact graph.

criteria.description: The reader independently selects the mocking/regression procedure, preserves a positive control, varies one valid semantic dimension per case, and asserts rejection at the relationship owner without unrelated conditional routing.

expected_behavior: Select references/mocking-and-regression.md; keep one canonical graph passing; separately substitute decision, acceptance identity, or accepted membership from the peer graph; restore the canonical graph between cases; and require no accepted descendant on failure. Skip browser, fixture, and test-plan-header procedures.
forbidden_behavior: Use malformed artifacts, stack multiple mutations, accept same-run or same-summary as sufficient lineage, or read unrelated procedures just in case.

safety_vetoes.description: The reader does not isolate or enforce the exact cross-artifact relationship.

cases.title: Independently review a multi-group schema test

executor_input.prompt: Independently review a multi-group schema test file.

context.content: The task creates, changes, or reviews a non-trivial integration, API, form-interaction, multi-branch Server Action, important-regression, concurrency, RLS, or multi-group test file.

criteria.description: The reader independently chooses schema tests, selects the eligible test-plan-header procedure, and skips browser, fixture, and mock procedures.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/test-plan-headers.md and skips references/smoke-e2e-and-browser.md, references/manual-qa-and-fixtures.md, and references/mocking-and-regression.md. The unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Require E2E or select a mock-specific procedure without a corresponding trigger.

cases.title: Independently assess a tiny helper test

executor_input.prompt: Independently assess one pure deterministic helper test.

context.content: The task concerns one pure deterministic helper test with no mock, bug regression, browser or manual QA, data fixture, or structured test-plan-header trigger.

criteria.description: The reader independently uses core lowest-layer and truthful-claim rules without selecting any conditional procedure.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate skips references/smoke-e2e-and-browser.md, references/manual-qa-and-fixtures.md, references/test-plan-headers.md, and references/mocking-and-regression.md. The unsplit baseline is judged on the same core behavior without future-reference obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Read conditional references just in case, require a large header, or demand E2E.
